title: Cross the carrier rail
story: A contamination screen divides the reservoir. Mica must pass through its only opening to deliver a test vial.
lesson: Inspect each row in the barrier column. Move vertically on the left, cross horizontally, then align with the dock on the right.
objective: The barrier is column 2. Use its open row. Return a legal route from the left side to the right side.
hint: Find the y where grid[y][2] == '.'. Vertical legs may go either way.
